name: Abyssal halftime Linn
desc: Halftime deep-sea electro: sparse heavy 808 kick, LinnDrum rim/clap backbeat on the 3, submerged 808 tom fills panning past like sonar contacts. Dark spacious pressure-hull groove.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ ~ [cp,rim] ~").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.6).room(${room}), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(sine.range(.18,.4).slow(32)), s("~ ~ ~ [~ mt lt ~]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.5).mask("<0 0 1 0>").pan(saw.range(.3,.7).slow(8))).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ ~ [cp,rim] ~, ~ ~ ~ [~ rim]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(${gain}*.55).room(${room}), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(".45 .2 .3 .2 .42 .2 .34 .25").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("mt(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.5), s("[~ oh]*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.28)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
